tha-ap183:1.1: Kumudavaggo aṭṭhādasamo. [181. Kuṭajapupphiya.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ sataraṃsīva uggataṃ / disaṃ anuvilokentaṃ gacchantam anilañjase // //
tha-ap183:2.1: Kuṭajaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā haṃ vitthatasamotthaṭaṃ / rukkhato ocinitvāna Phussassa abhiropayiṃ // //
tha-ap183:3.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap183:4.1: Ito sattarase kappe tayo āsiṃsu Pupphitā / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap183:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kuṭajapupphiyo thero i. g. ā-ti. Kuṭajapupphiyattherassa
